name: 710 Labs Live Rosin Badder | Fire Water #106
description:
Genetics: Firewood x Key Limeade

Our Rosin Badder, commonly known as cold cure, is a more stable form of our fresh press rosin. After the rosin is pressed, it is sealed into jars and left to cure at room temperature, forming an opaque, badder-like consistency with minimal terpene degradation. Our Live Rosin Badder micron distinctions echo the fresh press definitions.
